title: C4OS Grill Question 009 - Workspace Registry Layout

questions.label: How should user-config-owned workspaces and projects be stored?
questions.help: Recommended: app-level registry index plus one record per workspace. This keeps startup lookup simple while avoiding one giant mutable config file as workspace detail grows.
options: App-level registry index plus one record per workspace
Single user config file containing all workspaces and projects
One file per workspace with no central registry index
Database only, no readable config files for registry state

questions.label: How should saved workspace.c4os.json files relate to the user registry?
questions.help: Recommended: importing a workspace file creates or updates user-config registry records; saving exports a descriptor from registry state.
options: Import creates/updates registry records; save exports descriptor
Workspace files are live-linked to registry records
Workspace files are independent and bypass the user registry

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether chat/session indexes, project order, workspace name, collapse state, or search indexes belong in these files or app storage.
